# Update Specification

Use this fallback skill to keep specs synchronized with changing scope.

## Procedure
1. Review existing specification and change requests.
2. Update requirement sections and acceptance criteria.
3. Reconcile scope, risks, and dependency assumptions.
4. Publish a clean updated specification with change notes.
